focus: The verified release measures interruption pressure without identifying visitors, shows when call-to-action evidence needs more observations, and checks product destinations without treating timeouts as broken links. Account verification remains on its separate approval path.
nextStep: Publish this release and confirm it works, then gather enough anonymous grouped observations to make attention and destination trends useful. Complete the separate account review before changing any sign-in experience.

decisions.note: Expose a small deterministic mobile cohort and re-check close mix.
Refresh RUM UX ingestion before treating zero or low conversion as visitor behaviour.
Flip strict only after field p75 is sufficient and healthy.
Route top themes into feedback decision board lanes.
